sentences.literal: 嗨
sentences.note: 最随意通用的问候,任何场合都行;比 Hello 更口语。

sentences.literal: 好的 早晨
sentences.note: 早上见面用;白天用 Good afternoon,傍晚用 Good evening。注意 Good night 是睡前/道别,不用来打招呼。
variants: A very good morning to you!
Top of the morning!(爱尔兰俏皮)

sentences.literal: 怎么 是 你
sentences.note: 最常见寒暄;熟人之间也常说 How's it going? / What's up?。

sentences.frame: I'm ___, thanks. And you?(good / fine / great)
sentences.literal: 我是 好,谢谢。还有 你?
sentences.note: 回答 How are you 的标准说法;口语 good / fine / great 都行。
variants: I'm fine, thanks. How about you?

sentences.literal: 高兴 去 见 你
sentences.note: 初次见面用 meet;再次见面改用 see。
variants: It's a pleasure to meet you.(正式)

sentences.literal: 长 时间 没 见
sentences.note: 口语习惯说法,语法不规范但极常用;久别重逢时用。
variants: I haven't seen you in forever!

sentences.literal: 什么是 你的 名字
sentences.note: 问名字;May I have your name? 更礼貌正式。
variants: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.

sentences.literal: 我的 名字 是 ___
sentences.note: 自我介绍;口语里多用 I'm。

sentences.literal: 哪里 是 你 来自
sentences.note: 问来历;回答用 I'm from ___。
variants: What part of the world are you from?

sentences.literal: 见 你 稍后
sentences.note: 随意道别;正式场合可用 Goodbye。

sentences.target: I'd like a table for two, please.
sentences.frame: A table for ___, please.(two / three / four)
sentences.literal: 一张 桌子 给 两个,请
sentences.note: I'd like = I would like,礼貌点餐/订位的常用开头。
variants: Could we get a table for two?
Do you have a table for two?
A table for two, if possible.
Is there a table available for two?
sentences.ipa: aɪd laɪk ə ˈteɪbəl fɔːr tuː

sentences.target: Could I see the menu, please?
sentences.frame: Could I ___, please?(see the menu / order)
sentences.literal: 可以 我 看 这 菜单,请
sentences.note: Could I 比 Can I 更礼貌;点餐场景很实用。
variants: Can I have the menu, please?
Do you have a menu in English?

sentences.frame: What do you recommend ___?(for a starter / here)
sentences.literal: 什么 做 你 推荐
sentences.note: 向服务员问招牌菜时常用。

sentences.literal: 我将 有 这 一个,请
sentences.note: 点菜最常用句型;指着菜单说 this one 很方便。

sentences.literal: 我是 过敏的 对 花生
sentences.note: 点餐前主动告知过敏很重要;allergic 重音在第二个音节。
variants: Please make sure there are no peanuts.

sentences.target: Could I get some water, please?
sentences.frame: Could I get some ___, please?(water / bread / napkins)
sentences.literal: 可以 我 拿 一些 水,请
sentences.note: some 用于不可数/复数;加点东西时常用。对方可能反问 Still or sparkling?(平水还是气泡水)。
variants: Tap water is fine, thanks.(自来水即可)

sentences.literal: 什么 在 这 菜里
sentences.note: 问配料/做法;怕踩雷或有忌口时很有用。
variants: Does this have meat in it?
What kind of sauce is this?

sentences.target: Could we get the check, please?
sentences.frame: Could we get the ___, please?(check / bill)
sentences.literal: 可以 我们 拿 这 账单,请
sentences.note: 美式说 check,英式说 bill;饭后举手示意服务员即可。
variants: Can we have the bill, please?
How much do we owe you?

sentences.literal: 可以 我 付 用 卡
sentences.note: 问支付方式;by card / in cash。
variants: Can I pay with my phone?
Can we split the bill?(AA 分账)

sentences.literal: 那 是 美味的,谢谢
sentences.note: 饭后称赞;离店时对服务员说很自然。
variants: That hit the spot!(很满足,口语)

sentences.literal: 我是 只是 看,谢谢
sentences.note: 店员问 Can I help you? 时的礼貌回应,表示暂时不需要帮忙。
variants: I'll let you know if I need help.

sentences.literal: 多少 是 这个
sentences.note: 问价最常用;复数用 How much are these?。
variants: Could you tell me the price?

sentences.literal: 可以 我 试 这 上身
sentences.note: 试衣专用,try ... on 是固定搭配;问试衣间用 Where's the fitting room?。
variants: Do you have a fitting room?
Is it okay to try this on?
I'd like to try this on, please.

sentences.target: Do you have this in a bigger size?
sentences.frame: Do you have this in ___?(a bigger size / blue / medium)
sentences.literal: 有 你 这个 在 更大 号
sentences.note: 问尺码/颜色;小一号用 a smaller size。
variants: Do you have a larger size?
Does this come in a medium?
Do you have this in another color?
Is this the only size left?
Can you check the back for my size?
sentences.ipa: duː juː hæv ðɪs ɪn ə ˈbɪɡər saɪz

sentences.target: Can you give me a discount?
sentences.frame: Can you ___?(give me a discount / do a better price)
sentences.literal: 可以 你 给 我 一个 折扣
sentences.note: 市场/小店可议价;正规商场一般不讲价。
variants: Can you do a better price?
sentences.ipa: kæn juː ɡɪv miː ə ˈdɪskaʊnt

sentences.frame: I'll take ___.(this one / two / the red one)
sentences.literal: 我将 拿 这 一个
sentences.note: 决定购买时说;在购物语境里 take = 买下。

sentences.frame: Do you take ___?(card / cash / Apple Pay)
sentences.literal: 你 收 卡 吗
sentences.note: 结账问支付方式;take / accept 都可以。
variants: Can I tap to pay?(感应支付)

sentences.target: Could I get a bag, please?
sentences.frame: Could I get a ___, please?(bag / receipt)
sentences.literal: 可以 我 拿 一个 袋子,请
sentences.note: 很多地方袋子收费,可能被反问要不要袋子。
variants: Could you put it in a bag?
Do I need to pay for the bag?

sentences.literal: 可以 我 退 这个
sentences.note: 退货用 return,换货用 exchange;通常需要 receipt(收据)。

sentences.frame: Thanks, I'll ___.(think about it / come back later)
sentences.literal: 谢谢,我将 考虑 它
sentences.note: 暂时不想买时的礼貌脱身说法。
variants: I'll have a think about it.
